prompt: Which ASIC Regulatory Guide sets out ASIC's guidance on the content and presentation of Product Disclosure Statements (PDSs)? Answer with the RG number only (for example: "RG 123").

Which ASIC Regulatory Guide provides ASIC's guidance on the design and distribution obligations, including target market determinations, for issuers and distributors of financial products? Answer with the RG number only (for example: "RG 123").

An Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) holder must meet the general obligations in section 912A of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), including acting efficiently, honestly and fairly. Which ASIC Regulatory Guide sets out ASIC's guidance on meeting these general obligations? Answer with the RG number only (for example: "RG 123").

metadata.notes: Medium: requires mapping s 912A to the specific guiding RG rather than the AFSL application RG (RG 1-3) or the advice RG (RG 175).

prompt: AFS licensees must maintain internal dispute resolution (IDR) procedures that comply with ASIC standards. Which ASIC Regulatory Guide currently sets those IDR standards, having updated the framework that was previously located in parts of RG 165? Answer with the RG number only (for example: "RG 123").

metadata.notes: Medium: tests knowledge of the RG 165 to RG 271 transition (RG 271 effective 5 October 2021).

prompt: ASIC has made an order under Part 7.9A of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) preventing a specified credit product from being issued to retail clients without particular conditions, on the basis that the product is likely to cause significant consumer detriment. Which ASIC Regulatory Guide sets out ASIC's guidance on the exercise of that power? Answer with the RG number only (for example: "RG 123").

metadata.notes: Adversarial calibration probe: RG 272 (Product Intervention Power) is correct. Models may confidently answer RG 274 (Design and Distribution Obligations) because both regimes target retail-consumer-detriment outcomes and were introduced around the same time. A confident RG 274 answer is diagnostic of regime-conflation failure.
